_note: Scenario charters (Section 10). Synthetic data only. 'phase' follows Section 27. Limits come from the manifest. requiresRole uses the manifest's actualRole values.

scenarios.title: First-time trainee develops a vague idea
scenarios.goal: Get into EQUITAS from the start page, find where to begin a research idea, submit it, and understand the next steps it suggests.
syntheticFacts: I'm a PhD student in epidemiology in the US.
I have access to a county health department partnership but no funding yet.
I'm thinking of adults with uncontrolled hypertension in urban clinics.
I'm not sure about study design yet.
scenarios.question: I'm interested in whether community health workers could help people with high blood pressure. I don't know how to turn this into a research question yet. Can you help me?
followUps: I'm thinking of adults with uncontrolled hypertension in urban clinics, and I could work with a county health department.
scenarios.successCondition: EQUITAS asked clarifying questions or helped refine the idea into a specific question, and a next step is visible.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Refine population/outcome, or save the idea as a project.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Senior PI requests rigorous design critique
scenarios.goal: Find the fastest way to submit an advanced trial design for methodological critique and read the result.
scenarios.question: UXTEST synthetic design: Cluster-randomized trial, 24 primary-care clinics, CHW-led home BP telemonitoring + titration protocol vs usual care, adults 40-75 with uncontrolled hypertension (SBP>=140). Primary outcome: change in mean SBP at 12 months from clinic AOBP. Assume ICC 0.03, 40 patients/clinic, SD 18 mmHg, detect 5 mmHg. Please give a rigorous methodological critique: the most consequential threats to inference, ranked, and what you would change.
followUps: Which single change would most improve the validity of the primary comparison?
scenarios.successCondition: A specific, ranked critique of the design is shown.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Act on top-ranked issues; save to project.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: German investigator: research + funding applicability
scenarios.goal: Submit the research idea and find out which funding sources apply to an investigator based in Germany.
syntheticFacts: I am based at a university hospital in Germany.
I collaborate with a US university.
scenarios.question: UXTEST synthetic: I lead cardiovascular epidemiology at a German university hospital. I want to test a nurse-led home blood-pressure telemonitoring program in primary care practices in Germany, possibly with a US collaborator. What study design would you recommend, and which funding sources could apply to me as a Germany-based PI?
scenarios.successCondition: Design guidance plus funding information that addresses non-US eligibility (not only US mechanisms).
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Malawi-based senior PI: rigorous, feasible design
scenarios.goal: Get rigorous and feasible design advice and funding pointers for a CHW hypertension study in Malawi.
syntheticFacts: I am a senior lecturer at a public university in Malawi.
We have a small research office and intermittent internet.
District health offices already employ community health workers.
scenarios.question: UXTEST synthetic: I'm a senior PI at a public university in Malawi. I want to evaluate a community health worker-led hypertension screening and follow-up program across rural health centres. We have limited lab capacity and intermittent internet. What rigorous design is feasible here, and which funders could apply to a Malawi-based PI?
scenarios.successCondition: Advice that is rigorous, feasible in the stated context, and clear about funder eligibility uncertainty.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Returning investigator resumes a saved project
scenarios.goal: Find the project you saved last week (its name starts with UXTEST), open it, and see what EQUITAS recommended last time and what to do next.
scenarios.successCondition: The UXTEST project is found and opened, prior recommendations are visible, and a next action is clear.
scenarios.precondition: A UXTEST project must already exist for this account (create it in a P03 or P06 run with createSyntheticProjects=true, then log out and in again).
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Postdoc defines an independent line
scenarios.goal: Describe your research direction, ask how to make it independent of your mentor's program, and find early-career support options.
syntheticFacts: My mentor studies stress and sleep in adolescents.
I want to focus on digital interventions for sleep in first-year college students.
scenarios.question: UXTEST synthetic: I'm a postdoc in behavioral science. My mentor studies stress and sleep in adolescents. I want to develop my own line of research on digital interventions to improve sleep in first-year college students. How do I make this clearly independent, and what early-career funding should I consider?
scenarios.successCondition: Guidance on independence plus career-stage-appropriate funding options.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Junior faculty: program critique and save
scenarios.goal: Submit a program idea, get prioritized critique, and save it as a project named UXTEST-P03-program.
scenarios.question: UXTEST synthetic: I'm an assistant professor in health services research. I plan to use state all-payer claims data to estimate whether Medicaid expansion reduced avoidable hospitalizations for diabetes, using difference-in-differences with staggered adoption. Critique feasibility and the main threats, prioritized.
scenarios.successCondition: Prioritized critique visible and project saved (if creating projects is permitted).
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: ESI evaluates NIH mechanisms (funding-first)
scenarios.goal: Start from the funding side: find where EQUITAS helps with funding opportunities, ask about R21 vs R01 vs K-award fit, and link it to your project.
syntheticFacts: I received my PhD 4 years ago.
My R21 was not funded last cycle.
scenarios.question: UXTEST synthetic: I'm an assistant professor, PhD 4 years ago, so I think I'm an NIH early-stage investigator. My project studies sodium intake and blood pressure trajectories in young adults using an existing cohort. Should I apply for an R21, an R01, or a K award? What eligibility issues should I check?
scenarios.successCondition: Mechanism comparison with eligibility caveats and no award prediction; link back to research project.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Mid-career investigator explores how sections relate
scenarios.goal: Without being told section names, find out what the main sections of EQUITAS are, open each one, and work out how they relate to a single research project. Do not submit anything.
scenarios.successCondition: Agent can state what each main section is for and how it connects to a project.
scenarios.expectedNextAction: Choose the section that fits a portfolio-redirect goal.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Scientific question revision
scenarios.goal: Submit a research question, read the answer, then submit a materially different question for the same work and see how EQUITAS handles the change.
scenarios.question: UXTEST synthetic: I'm interested in whether community health workers could help people with high blood pressure. I don't know how to turn this into a research question yet. Can you help me?
followUps: Change of plan: my question is now about medication adherence in adults with type 2 diabetes, not blood pressure. The outcome is proportion of days covered for metformin.
scenarios.successCondition: After the revision, EQUITAS recognises the change and addresses diabetes medication adherence rather than blood pressure, or asks to clarify.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Consortium PI: multi-site design and governance
scenarios.goal: Submit a multi-site study plan and get design and governance considerations.
scenarios.question: UXTEST synthetic: I lead a 9-site network (7 US, 2 non-US). We plan a stepped-wedge pragmatic trial of an early-mobility protocol in ICUs; outcome is days alive and out of hospital at 90 days. What design, site-variability and governance issues should we address?
scenarios.successCondition: Specific multi-site design and governance considerations.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Clinical question: SGLT2 inhibitors and AKI
scenarios.goal: Get an assessment of a retrospective clinical research question.
scenarios.question: UXTEST synthetic: Using our health system's EHR data, I want to study whether starting an SGLT2 inhibitor vs a DPP-4 inhibitor is associated with acute kidney injury within 1 year in adults with type 2 diabetes. How should I design this, and what are the main biases?
scenarios.successCondition: Design guidance addressing confounding, time-related biases and regulatory points.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Basic science: mechanistic hypothesis
scenarios.goal: Get discipline-appropriate critique of a mechanistic hypothesis and experiments.
scenarios.question: UXTEST synthetic: Hypothesis: SMAD3 in fibroblasts is required for bleomycin-induced lung fibrosis. Plan: fibroblast-specific SMAD3 knockout mice vs littermate controls, bleomycin at day 0, hydroxyproline and histology at day 21. Please critique the experimental design and mechanistic inference.
scenarios.successCondition: Bench-appropriate critique (controls, replication, model limits, inference).
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Computational: imaging model generalizability
scenarios.goal: Get critique of a computational project's validation and reproducibility.
scenarios.question: UXTEST synthetic: I trained a convolutional network on 80,000 chest X-rays from one hospital to detect pneumonia (AUC 0.94 on a random 20% split). I want to publish and seek funding to deploy it. What are the main validity, generalizability and reproducibility concerns?
scenarios.successCondition: Critique covering leakage, external validation, calibration, shift and reporting.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Under-resourced US investigator
scenarios.goal: Get feasible, rigorous next steps for a community study without a research office or statistician.
syntheticFacts: I teach four courses per semester.
There is no research office or biostatistician at my university.
scenarios.question: UXTEST synthetic: I'm at a small rural university with no research office or statistician. I'd like to study whether a church-based blood pressure check program helps people get their hypertension controlled. What is a rigorous but feasible first study, and what support could I find?
scenarios.successCondition: Feasible, rigorous, prioritized advice that does not assume missing infrastructure.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Research-development administrator
scenarios.goal: From the public website, find how EQUITAS supports faculty and what institutional access, governance and privacy boundaries exist. Do not sign up.
scenarios.successCondition: Institutional use cases, access model and governance/privacy information are found or confirmed absent.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Research dean evaluates institutional value
scenarios.goal: From the public website, find the value proposition, faculty-development use cases, and institutional licensing information.
scenarios.successCondition: Licensing and institutional value information found, or its absence recorded.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: IT/privacy reviewer looks for documentation
scenarios.goal: From the public website, find the privacy policy, terms, which AI services process user content, data retention and training use, SSO or institutional controls, and a security contact.
scenarios.successCondition: Each item found (with location) or recorded as not found.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: New individual subscriber chooses a plan
scenarios.goal: Sign-up has been completed by the founder for this new test account. Understand the plans, pick the one you are authorized to use, and enter the product. Stop before any payment.
scenarios.successCondition: Plan contents understood and product entered without payment (or stopped at payment with reason recorded).
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Verified funder representative
scenarios.goal: Find funder features: verification status, what investigator information is visible, and communication rules.
scenarios.successCondition: Funder features located and their boundaries understood.
scenarios.note: Run only if the funder role is implemented and an approved funder account exists. Otherwise BLOCKED / NOT IMPLEMENTED.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Founder locates admin oversight functions
scenarios.goal: Find, without changing anything: founder dashboard, user administration, roles/permissions, subscription oversight, analytics, platform configuration, service status, audit information, and account-recovery information. Note which you find.
scenarios.successCondition: Each function located or recorded as not found.
scenarios.evidenceRequired: Step screenshots, accessibility snapshots, navigation path, captured EQUITAS response text, network/console errors, guard decisions.

scenarios.title: Incomplete input and validation messages
scenarios.goal: Find where to start a research idea and try submitting it with almost no detail, then see whether the site explains what is missing.
scenarios.question: UXTEST hypertension?
scenarios.successCondition: A clear, accessible validation or clarification message appears.
